label: Convoclub
summary: Convoclub is a community of practice for conversation designers, linguists, bot builders and language lovers that Maaike started in late 2021. It began as a weekly Clubhouse room and grew into a broader space with meetups, online courses and a resource library. By the two-year mark it had reached 700 members.
how_maaike_uses: Maaike uses Convoclub as both a gathering space and a research instrument. She asks every new member the same onboarding question about the challenges they face, which after two years produced over 300 responses she could analyse and share back with the community. The community also serves as a vehicle for her own learning and course production, including a free course on imposter syndrome that she built directly in response to what members reported.
open_questions: The passages mention more online courses in the pipeline but give no detail on what those cover or when they will arrive.
It is unclear how Convoclub evolved beyond Clubhouse, given that it started there but the later post describes meetups and a resource list without explaining the platform shift.
